title: Consumer sends money to a new recipient with Zelle (Citi Mobile App)
customer_goal: Pay a friend back in minutes using only their email or U.S. mobile number

governance.access_policy: Public-source competitive intelligence; legal review before external sharing

moments.title: Customer finds Zelle inside the Citi Mobile App (App Store/Google Play…
moments.customer_action: Customer finds Zelle inside the Citi Mobile App (App Store/Google Play list 'Zelle: pay and split payments'); Citi's guide says Zelle is 'built into the Citi Mobile App'

touchpoints.screen: Citi Mobile App / Citi Online menu item 'Zelle®' or 'Send Money with Zelle®' (citi.com: Services > MOVE YOUR MONEY > Send Money with Zelle®)

moments.frontstage: App surfaces Zelle to eligible checking customers

fail_points.text: Marketing pages (citi.com/banking/zelle) are JS shells; public navigation labels not verifiable

moments.title: Customer enrolls with an email address, U.S. mobile number or Zelle tag…
moments.customer_action: Customer enrolls with an email address, U.S. mobile number or Zelle tag (landline/VoIP/Google Voice not eligible) and accepts the Citibank with Zelle Terms via 'I Agree'
moments.frontstage: Citi may validate the email/mobile (one-time code) and may decline enrollment; token registered to the Zelle directory; a Z logo marks enrolled tokens
moments.decision: Validation passes vs. Citi declines enrollment

moments.title: Customer optionally allows the Citi Mobile App to access phone contacts…
moments.customer_action: Customer optionally allows the Citi Mobile App to access phone contacts (device privacy settings) and adds a recipient by email, U.S. mobile number, Zelle tag or by scanning the recipient's Zelle QR code
moments.frontstage: Bank checks the Zelle directory; shows whether the token is enrolled
moments.decision: Recipient enrolled vs. not enrolled -> 14-day enrollment window applies if not enrolled

moments.title: Customer selects the funding checking account, enters the amount (up to…
moments.customer_action: Customer selects the funding checking account, enters the amount (up to available balance and send limits) and optional memo; consumer accounts may pick a future send date (one-time only; recurring not allowed)

touchpoints.screen: Zelle® > Send Money > Select Recipient (device contacts, add email/U.S. mobile, or QR icon at top of screen) > amount > optional note

moments.frontstage: Applies untenured/tenured daily and rolling-30-day limits; lower limits after new enrollment or profile/device/carrier changes, with in-service notice

fail_points.text: Untenured status caps new enrollees at $500/day for consumers

moments.title: Customer reviews recipient and amount; Citi warns that money goes only…
moments.customer_action: Customer reviews recipient and amount; Citi warns that money goes only to the token entered 'even if it belongs to someone other than your intended recipient' and that Zelle is for people you know and trust with no purchase protection

touchpoints.screen: Review screen > 'Send' (confirm displayed name for new recipients; no purchase protection; limits displayed when sending)

moments.frontstage: Zelle network rules require in-app alerts before a payment is sent and real-time risk tools; Citi may delay or block transfers for fraud/regulatory reasons and notifies the sender
moments.decision: Proceed vs. edit; bank risk engine may hold or block

fail_points.text: Specific Citi scam-interstitial wording and any step-up OTP at send are not documented publicly (INFERRED from network rules)

moments.title: Customer is signed on via biometrics (Touch ID/Face ID) or a 6 Digit…
moments.customer_action: Customer is signed on via biometrics (Touch ID/Face ID) or a 6 Digit PIN (documented for funds-transfer sign-on in the Online Funds Transfer terms) and taps 'Send'; no Zelle-specific step-up authentication is published

touchpoints.screen: Face ID / Touch ID / 6 Digit PIN

moments.frontstage: Citi treats requests meeting the security procedure as authorized

moments.title: Citi submits the payment to the Zelle network; funds typically arrive…
moments.frontstage: Debit posts to checking; payment appears on statement as a Zelle transfer
moments.decision: Enrolled recipient -> deposited directly; not enrolled -> pending up to 14 calendar days

moments.title: Customer and recipient receive confirmation; recipient gets email/SMS…
moments.frontstage: Emails and texts from Citi (short code 50449), Zelle, other users or institutions
moments.notification: Email/SMS to recipient; in-app activity for sender

moments.title: Customer views Zelle activity and statements; a scheduled one-time…
moments.customer_action: Customer views Zelle activity and statements; a scheduled one-time payment can be cancelled up to one calendar day before its send date in the Citi Mobile App; a sent payment can be cancelled only while the recipient is not yet enrolled

touchpoints.screen: Zelle® activity page > choose payment > 'Cancel' (only shown while recipient is not enrolled; otherwise Contact Us)

moments.frontstage: Cancellation removes the pending payment; once an enrolled recipient's bank has the funds it cannot be stopped
moments.decision: Recipient enrolled (no cancel) vs. pending (cancel allowed)

moments.title: Recipient does not enroll within 14 calendar days (or does not accept…
Customer sent to the wrong token: Citi states the customer remains…
moments.customer_action: Customer sent to the wrong token: Citi states the customer remains responsible if funds cannot be recovered; customer contacts Citi to attempt recovery
moments.frontstage: Citi may attempt recovery; no guarantee

fail_points.text: No in-app 'recall' for misdirected Zelle payments

moments.title: Unauthorized Zelle transfer or qualifying imposter scam: customer…
moments.customer_action: Unauthorized Zelle transfer or qualifying imposter scam: customer reports to Citi; Citi investigates under the Electronic Banking section of the Client Manual (Reg E procedures: provisional credit within 10 Business Days, up to 45/90 days)

touchpoints.screen: Contact Us (post-login Chat) or CitiPhone / number on back of card; 'Qualifying imposter scams may be eligible for reimbursement'

moments.frontstage: Reimbursement 'available for unauthorized transactions and certain qualifying imposter scams' per Citi's Zelle T&Cs (aligned to the Zelle network policy); authorized purchase scams are not covered
moments.decision: Unauthorized or qualifying imposter scam (reimbursed) vs. authorized purchase scam (not covered)

moments.title: Customer gets help in-app or calls CitiPhone Banking (1-888-CITIBANK /…
moments.customer_action: Customer gets help in-app or calls CitiPhone Banking (1-888-CITIBANK / 1-800-374-9700, 24/7, TTY 711); fraud is reported via the number on the back of the Citibank Banking Card

touchpoints.screen: Citi Mobile App help / CitiPhone Banking

moments.frontstage: Contact center authenticates and opens a claim or investigation; written follow-up may be required within 10 Business Days for phone claims

fail_points.text: No evidence of an in-app virtual assistant handling money-movement disputes; phone remains the escalation path.

status_tracking.where: Zelle activity in Citi Mobile App / Citi Online; statement line items

exceptions.customer_experience: Payment shows pending then is cancelled; funds stay in checking
Customer calls Citi; may need written confirmation within 10 Business Days
exceptions.bank_handling: Reg E investigation; provisional credit within 10 Business Days (20 for new accounts); up to 45/90 days

exceptions.trigger: Customer reports an imposter scam (authorized push payment)
exceptions.customer_experience: Customer is told to 'Please Contact Us' (post-login Chat or phone); Citi states 'Qualifying imposter scams may be eligible for reimbursement'; Fraud and Scam Prevention Central lists post-scam steps (report, FTC/IC3, safeguard accounts, secure devices)
exceptions.bank_handling: Citi evaluates against Zelle network imposter-scam criteria (bank/government/business impersonation); authorized purchase scams excluded
exceptions.resolution: Reimbursed if qualifying; otherwise denied with no purchase protection

exceptions.trigger: Payment delayed/blocked by Citi or Zelle risk controls
exceptions.customer_experience: Customer sees delayed status and is notified
exceptions.resolution: Released or blocked; customer may contact Citi

assessment: Mature Zelle implementation with QR, Zelle tag, scheduling and Split; strong tenure-based limit model. Weak public documentation of the actual in-app screens and scam interstitial copy; cancellation of scheduled payments is mobile-only per T&Cs.

terms.limits: Consumer untenured $500/day, $2,500/30 days; tenured Standard $2,500/day, $15,000/30 days; Citi Priority/Citigold/CPC/Private Bank $5,000/day, $20,000/30 days (S001)
terms.cutoffs: Daily limits reset 12:00 AM ET; typically minutes to arrive
